body.statement: At every compatible explanation, \[\dim\ker(D_WF)=\sum_{\lambda\in\Lambda}\frac{k_\lambda(k_\lambda-1)}{2}.\] The derivative of the full Gaussian parameter-to-moment map has the same kernel after the Stein, measurement-covariance, equilibrium, and initial-mean coordinates are included. Consequently the branchwise Fisher information is nonsingular exactly on the finite raw strata \(k_\lambda\le1\) for all \(\lambda\).
body.justification: This equality turns geometric nonidentification into an exact statistical-information diagnosis.
body.gap: Drton2009 derives tangent-cone limits for general semialgebraic singularities, but no inspected work identifies the nullity of snapshot information with an orthogonal stabilizer dimension.
body.consumer: Branch diagnostics can use \(\gamma_W\) to distinguish a regular repeated-eigenvalue branch from a genuinely positive-dimensional ambiguity.
